description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide WASH, nutrition and child protection services to vulnerable people in Cameroon. This UNICEF project constructs water wells, provides sanitation facilities, aims to prevent and treat acute malnutrition in children, and strengthens child protection mechanisms, among other activities. The project provides life-saving assistance to 95,000 people in the Nutrition sector, 40,000 people in the WASH sector, and 42,000 people in the Protection (CP) sector.
